title: Warranty Coverage Owner Acceptance of a Prorated Sealed Glass Replacement
content:
Warranty Coverage prices the owner's share when the owner accepts the prorated replacement of sealed glass units approved with proration on a seal-failure claim, and books it on the warranty charges of the registration with the units accepted. For an insulated glass claim approved with proration, the owner pays the share; Ridgeline pays the rest and the labor follows the labor term as for any other approval. The share is booked once as a prorated parts share on the date the owner accepts the prorated replacement, not on the decision date, and an owner who has not accepted it owes no share.

## When the share is fixed

The owner's share of a prorated replacement is fixed only after the records carry a labor charge entry for every technician visit on the claim that the warranty terms bill labor for.

In other words, while any technician visit on the claim that the warranty terms bill labor for has no labor charge entry in the records, the owner's share of the prorated replacement is not yet fixed.

## What the acceptance tool does

`accept_prorated_glass_share_5fbbc0c6` records the registered owner accepting, in person, a prorated replacement of sealed glass units approved on a seal-failure claim and agreeing to pay the owner's share. One call adds one prorated parts share entry, dated today, to the warranty charges of the registration, tied to the claim, carrying the claim's component and the number of units accepted; the amount the owner owes rises by exactly that share. Nothing else on the registration or the claim changes. The owner sees the share among the warranty charges.

## How it is invoked

This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `accept_prorated_glass_share_5fbbc0c6` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `warranty_registration_id` | the registration the claim was decided under, as returned by the warranty registration lookup | identifier |
| `warranty_claim_id` | the seal-failure claim approved with proration, as returned by the warranty claim lookup | identifier |
| `units` | the number of sealed units approved for prorated replacement on the claim's decision and accepted by the owner | non-negative integer count |
| `share_amount` | the owner's share the owner agrees to pay | USD, a positive amount rounded half up to 2 decimal places |

## Return

A receipt with `warranty_activity_id` (the reference of the new share entry), `warranty_registration_id` (the registration charged), `warranty_claim_id` (the claim the share belongs to), `charge_kind` (always `prorated_parts_share`), `activity_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today's date), `units` (the units accepted) and `share_amount` (USD to 2 decimal places, the share booked). A receipt carrying a `warranty_activity_id` means the share is recorded.
